name: CYNTHIA'S OF BEND
address: 1245 SE 3RD ST STE C-1, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Open Lawn Area; Detached Structure; Storage Area; Equipment Storage Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation; Detached Structure Complexity; Fenced Sections
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Trim vegetation along the front driveway to maintain clear sightlines and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Keep a rear access gate unlocked or secured with a breakaway latch to allow responders to reach the back of the property without delay.
• Mark any secondary access points with clearly visible signage so arriving responders can quickly identify all entry options.
• Clear a direct walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Remove stored equipment or materials from in front of the detached structure to allow responders to approach and work around it freely.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders have an unobstructed line of sight between the two buildings.
• Post the property address visibly at the detached structure if it has a separate entrance from the main driveway.
• Keep the parking area clear enough that emergency vehicles can pull in and turn around without being blocked by parked vehicles.
• Identify which fenced sections have gates and mark those gates so responding crews do not waste time searching for access points along the perimeter.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to any structures to increase open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove low-hanging branches from scattered trees close to structures so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep the open terrain areas between tree clusters and structures free of accumulated dead grass, leaves, and debris.
• Maintain all access routes by trimming any branches or vegetation that overhang or narrow the travel path.
